local HitboxModule = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Instancers.Hitbox)
local NewReach = Vector3.new(50, 50, 50)
local oldNew = HitboxModule.new

HitboxModule.new = function(...)
    local obj = oldNew(...)
    
    if obj and obj.HitBox then
        obj.HitBox.Size = NewReach
        task.spawn(function()
            while obj and obj.HitBox and obj.HitBox.Parent do
                if obj.HitBox.Size ~= NewReach then
                    obj.HitBox.Size = NewReach
                end
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end
    
    return obj
end
